title: MarkTune: Improving the Quality-Detectability Trade-off in Model-Embedded LLM Watermarking
abstract: arXiv:2512.04044v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Language model watermarking schemes fall into two broad categories: inference-time methods, which modify the decoding process at generation time, and model-embedded methods, which encode a secret signal directly into the model weights. Inference-time watermarking methods incur additional inference overhead and are not applicable in the increasingly prevalent open-weight model settings. In contrast, model-embedded watermarks introduce no additional inference latency-generation uses the standard sampling pipeline-and are particularly well-suited to open-weight settings. However, existing model-embedded approaches such as GaussMark face a fundamental quality-detectability trade-off: achieving strong detection power typically requires weight perturbations that noticeably degrade generation quality. Our key insight is that regularizing toward a high-quality reference distribution decouples quality preservation from proximity to the base m

translated_title: MarkTune：改进模型嵌入式大语言模型水印的质量-可检测性权衡
translated_abstract: 语言模型水印方案大致可分为两大类：推理时方法（在生成时修改解码过程）和模型嵌入方法（将秘密信号直接编码到模型权重中）。推理时水印方法会引入额外的推理开销，且不适用于日益普及的开放权重模型场景。相比之下，模型嵌入水印不会带来额外的推理延迟（生成时使用标准的采样流程），因此特别适合开放权重场景。然而，现有的模型嵌入方法（如GaussMark）面临一个根本性的质量-可检测性权衡：要获得强大的检测能力，通常需要对权重进行扰动，而这会明显降低生成质量。我们的关键洞察是，向一个高质量的参考分布进行正则化，可以将质量保持与对基础模型的接近程度解耦（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出MarkTune，通过向高质量参考分布正则化来解耦质量保持与检测能力之间的关系，从而改进了模型嵌入式大语言模型水印中生成质量与可检测性之间的权衡。
en_tdlr: MarkTune improves the quality-detectability trade-off in model-embedded LLM watermarking by regularizing toward a high-quality reference distribution, decoupling quality preservation from detection strength.
